title: Persist completion timestamps and backfill legacy tickets
description: Set completedAt on entry into done through every write path. Clear on leaving done. Add an explicit idempotent dry-run-capable backfill from updatedAt without silently rewriting reads.
why: Deliver the reviewed roadmap plan without regressions in existing project workflows.

acceptance.text: Lifecycle and legacy regression tests pass
Backfill preserves updatedAt and is idempotent

outcome.summary: Added managed completion timestamps, reopen clearing and durable estimated-date provenance. Backfilled 14 legacy records with all existing fields preserved; rerun changed zero records. Serialized updates and backfill to prevent lost concurrent edits.
outcome.verifiedBy: Windows Node 24: npm run check 91 passed, 1 opt-in real-model test skipped; final roadmap tests 14/14; TypeScript declarations 0 diagnostics; browser verification at 1280x850 and 320x740; 2000-ticket benchmark warm timeline 22ms, structure 82ms.
